summary: Candidate commit 228043c plausibly corrects rank-local SCATTERED PP proxy row views in decode graph capture/replay and dummy warmup, but its regression tests only helper arithmetic and the original 8x gfx942 GLM-5.3 DSA multi-chunk serving failure could not be reproduced or cleared on the assigned single gfx950 GPU. An adjacent prefill graph capture path still uses global rows.

tests.what_was_measured: The exact candidate's helper regression and neighboring decode graph/buffer registry suite: 57 passed. This did not run PP communication or the original serving workload.

Independent helper boundaries plus a real-gfx950 tensor passed through PrefillCudaGraphRunner._capture_pp_proxy_tensors; helper returned 8 local rows for global=32/TP=4, while the adjacent prefill capture path returned 32 rows and did not consult scattered-boundary state.
Candidate diff has whitespace errors only in candidate-owned report artifacts; no runtime source whitespace error was reported.

gpu_evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950:sramecc+:xnack- was visible and used for an independent tensor/capture-shape probe. This is not the issue's 8x MI300X gfx942 architecture.
remaining_counterexamples: PrefillCudaGraphRunner._capture_pp_proxy_tensors still returns global num_tokens rows and does not apply the candidate's SCATTERED attention-TP row-count invariant.
No evidence shows that 43k with full or 100k with tc_piecewise stops faulting on 8x gfx942 TP=4/PP=2 GLM-5.3 DSA.
No evidence covers the overlap-scheduler first-request failure reported in the same issue.
The candidate's failing-before test is a missing-symbol import error, not reproduction of incorrect graph proxy shapes or the HIP fault.
remaining_limitations: Only one gfx950 GPU was assigned; the report requires 8x gfx942 and distributed TP=4/PP=2 or PP=4.
The zai-org/GLM-5.3 753B FP8 weights were unavailable.
The original request-length and decode-backend matrix was not executable.
The tiny Llama fixture cannot validate GLM DSA semantics, gfx942 behavior, or distributed PP and was not used as substitute proof.
No native files changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
